issues.description: The problem statement specifies a static method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal): int, but the solution implements this functionality in a method named computeMealCost(Meal). Additionally, the template and solution Main files reference different names: the template Main calls computeMealCost, while the solution Main calls calculateTotalPrice. This name/signature mismatch across artifacts will confuse students about which method to implement and may cause compilation or test failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method name across all artifacts. Rename the solution method computeMealCost(Meal) to calculateTotalPrice(Meal) (keeping it static and returning int), and update all references in Main and other code to call calculateTotalPrice. Alternatively, if computeMealCost is preferred, update the problem statement and tests to expect computeMealCost instead.

issues.description: The problem statement / UML specifies a static method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal) as the operation to compute a meal's total cost, but the implementation in the repositories uses the identifier computeMealCost for that static method. Additionally, Main in the template/solution references different names (both computeMealCost and calculateTotalPrice appear across files), creating an unclear mapping between the required API and the provided implementation. Students may look for calculateTotalPrice as required by the exercise but find computeMealCost (or vice versa), which creates unnecessary confusion when implementing or invoking the method.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a single consistent method name for the meal cost calculation across all artifacts. Prefer matching the problem statement: rename the static method computeMealCost to calculateTotalPrice (signature: public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)) and update all call sites (Main, template references) accordingly so the required API exactly matches the UML/instructions.
